summary: Four-pose reference sheet for Stamp Bouncer, the Club DB security bouncer responsible for stamping and verifying completed work. Shows neutral standing, stop / not-published, approve / completion receipt, and stamping / publication proof poses with signature props.

character: Bearded adult man with medium-brown skin
Wears a black baseball cap and black Club DB security polo
Friendly but official facial expression and posture
costume: Black short-sleeve polo with Club DB patch on the chest
Black trousers with belt and black work shoes
Employee badge on a lanyard labeled STAMP BOUNCER
signature_props: Purple stamp with round handle and base
Paper receipt held in the other hand
Publication / completion proof document with APPROVED or COMPLETED seal
poses: 1: Neutral standing holding stamp and receipt
2: Stop / not-published pose with raised palm and NOT PUBLISHED sign
3: Approve / completion receipt with thumbs up and APPROVED paper
4: Stamping / publication proof pressing stamp onto COMPLETED document
color_notes: Dominant black uniform with white badge text
Purple stamp as the key accent color
White/grey paper props with green check marks and red X as status marks

positive_constraints: Always include the purple stamp and a paired receipt or proof document in every pose
Keep the black cap, black Club DB polo, black trousers, and black work shoes
Maintain friendly but official body language and clear facial expression
Retain the lanyard badge labeled STAMP BOUNCER
negative_constraints: Do not change the stamp color away from purple
Do not omit the receipt or publication proof from stamped poses
Do not add unrelated accessories, weapons, or alternate costumes
Do not alter the Club DB patch or badge text
